Access.name: luogoAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct CAP_X_LOC from CLL.CAP where GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and DAT_FINE_VALID = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') and trim(CAP_X_LOC) like upper(
autocompleteTerm%) and trim(CAP_X_LOC) = upper(
luogo) order by CAP_X_LOC

Access.name: toponimoAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select COD, DESCR from DAICREF.CCB_ANAGRAFICA_DECOD where TIPO = 'TIPO-VIA-INFORETE' and nvl(trim(COD),' ') != ' ' and ATTIVO = 'S' and trim(DESCR) like upper(
autocompleteTerm%) and trim(DESCR) = upper(
descrToponimo) order by DESCR

Access.name: comuneAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct 'I', 'ITALIA', CAP_C_PROV, CAP_C_CAP, CAP_X_LOC from CLL.CAP where GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and DAT_FINE_VALID = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy')
and trim(CAP_C_PROV) like upper(
autocompleteTerm%)
and trim(CAP_C_CAP) like upper(
autocompleteTerm%)
and trim(CAP_X_LOC) like upper(
autocompleteTerm%)
and trim(CAP_C_PROV) = upper(
provinciaComune) and trim(CAP_C_CAP) = upper(
capComune) and trim(CAP_X_LOC) = upper(
comune) order by CAP_X_LOC

Access.name: agePersonAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select A.AGE_C_AGE , A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE as cognome , A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE as nome from INR_AGENTI A where 1 = 1 and A.AGE_C_AGE like
%codice and A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE like upper(
nome%) and A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE like upper(
cognome%) and A.AGE_X_CF_AGE like upper(
codiceFiscale%) and (A.AGE_N_PIVA_AGE like upper(
partitaIva%) and A.AGE_N_PIVA_AGE != '00000000000') and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE))) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE))) like (isnull(upper(
cognomeNome)+'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE))) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE))) like (isnull(upper(
cognomeNome)+'%','%'))) and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE))) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE))) like (isnull(upper(
nomeCognome)+'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE))) + ' ' + ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE))) like (isnull(upper(
nomeCognome)+'%','%'))) and ((A.AGE_X_CF_AGE like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%)) or (A.AGE_N_PIVA_AGE like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%) and A.AGE_N_PIVA_AGE != '00000000000')) order by 1 asc order by 2, 3 asc

Access.name: personAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct B.AGE_C , A.CLI_C as ndg , '' as idCensimento , A.CLI_M_COGN as cognome , A.CLI_M_NOM as nome , A.CLI_C_SEC_INT as secondaIntestazione from CLL.CLI A inner join CLL.CLIAGE B on A.CLI_C = B.CLI_C
inner join CLL.LEGM_CLI_AGENT_COGEST C on C.CLI_C = A.CLI_C and C.COD_RUOLO_AGENT =
codRuoloImpersonato and C.COD_AGENT =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and C.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
where 1 = 1 and trim(leading '0' from A.CLI_C) like trim(leading '0' from
ndg)||'%' and 1 = 2 and A.CLI_M_NOM like upper(
nome%) and A.CLI_M_COGN like upper(
cognome%) and A.CLI_C_SEC_INT like upper(
secondaIntestazione%) and A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscale%) and (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
partitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000') and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%'))) and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%'))) and ((A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%)) or (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000')) and B.AGE_C =
codAgente and trunc(sysdate) between B.CLIAGE_D_INIZ and B.CLIAGE_D_FINE and A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and B.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
union
select distinct B.AGE_C , A.CLI_C as ndg , '' as idCensimento , A.CLI_M_COGN as cognome , A.CLI_M_NOM as nome , A.CLI_C_SEC_INT as secondaIntestazione from CLL.CLI A inner join CLL.LEGM_CLI_SECON_AGENT B on A.CLI_C = B.CLI_C
inner join CLL.LEGM_CLI_AGENT_COGEST C on C.CLI_C = A.CLI_C and C.COD_RUOLO_AGENT =
codRuoloImpersonato and C.COD_AGENT =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and C.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
where 1 = 1 and trim(leading '0' from A.CLI_C) like trim(leading '0' from
ndg)||'%' and 1 = 2 and A.CLI_M_NOM like upper(
nome%) and A.CLI_M_COGN like upper(
cognome%) and A.CLI_C_SEC_INT like upper(
secondaIntestazione%) and A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscale%) and (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
partitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000') and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%'))) and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOM))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%'))) and ((A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%)) or (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000')) and B.AGE_C =
codAgente and A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and B.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
union
select distinct A.AGE_C_AGE , '' as ndg , A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE as idCensimento , A.CLI_M_COGN as cognome , A.CLI_M_NOME as nome , A.CLI_X_SECONDA_INTEST as secondaIntestazione from CLL.INR_CLI_ELETTR_REP A
inner join CLL.LEGM_PROSPCT_AGENT_COGEST D on D.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and D.COD_RUOLO_AGENT =
codRuoloImpersonato and D.COD_AGENT =
contextCurrentLinkedUserCode and D.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
where 1 = 1 and 1 = 2 and A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE =
idCensimento and A.CLI_M_NOME like upper(
nome%) and A.CLI_M_COGN like upper(
cognome%) and A.CLI_X_SECONDA_INTEST like upper(
secondaIntestazione%) and A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscale%) and (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
partitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000') and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOME))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOME))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
cognomeNome)||'%','%'))) and (ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOME))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%')) or ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_NOME))) || ' ' || ltrim(rtrim(upper(A.CLI_M_COGN))) like (nvl(upper(
nomeCognome)||'%','%'))) and ((A.CLI_X_CF like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%)) or (A.CLI_N_PIVA like upper(
codiceFiscalePartitaIva%) and A.CLI_N_PIVA != '00000000000')) and A.AGE_C_AGE =
codAgente and A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL is null
union
select distinct B.AGE_C , A.CLI_C as ndg , '' as idCensimento , A.CLI_M_COGN as cognome , A.CLI_M_NOM as nome , A.CLI_C_SEC_INT as secondaIntestazione from CLL.CLI A inner join CLL.CLIAGE B on A.CLI_C = B.CLI_C where 1 = 1 and 1 = 2 and A.CLI_C = lpad(
ndg, 11, '0') and trunc(sysdate) between B.CLIAGE_D_INIZ and B.CLIAGE_D_FINE and A.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and B.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S'
order by 4, 5 asc

Access.name: contoAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select distinct
tipoConto as tipoConto , CLIAGE1.AGE_Cnull as codAgente , CONTRCLI.CLI_C as ndgCliente , CONTR.CONTR_N as numeroContoOriginale , CONTR.CONTR_N as numeroEstesoConto , substr(CONTR.CONTR_N,5,8) as numeroConto , 'IT' || nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,1,13),' ') || substr('000000000000' || substr(CONTR.CONTR_N,5,8),-12) as ibanConto , CONTR.CONTR_D_CARICAM as dataAperturaConto , to_char(extract(year from CONTR.CONTR_D_CARICAM)) as annoAperturaConto , 'IT' as paeseIbanConto , nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,1,2),' ') as cinEuropeoIbanConto , nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,3,1),' ') as cinControlloIbanConto , nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,4,5),' ') as abiIbanConto , nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,9,5),' ') as cabIbanConto , substr('000000000000'||substr(CONTR.CONTR_N,5,8),-12) as numeroIbanConto , CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR as codiceRuoloConto , (select DES_RUOLO_CONTR from SOGG_POSIZINFORM.LEGM_RUOLO_TIPO_PROD_CONTR where trim(COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR) = 'CC' and trim(COD_RUOLO_CONTR_CLI) = trim(CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR) and rownum=1) as ruoloConto , CONTR.CONTR_C_CAT as categoriaConto , CONTR.CONTR_C_SCAT as sottocategoriaConto , CONTR.CONTR_C_CONV as convenzioneConto , CONTR.CONTR_C_DIV as divisaConto , DSC.FLG_STATO_BLOC as isContoAttivoMaBloccato
from CLL.CLIAGE CLIAGE inner join CLL.CONTRCLI CONTRCLI on CLIAGE.CLI_C = CONTRCLI.CLI_C inner join CLL.CONTR CONTR on CONTRCLI.CONTR_N = CONTR.CONTR_N and CONTRCLI.PROD_C = CONTR.PROD_C inner join CLL.CONTRCLI CONTRCLI1 on CONTR.PROD_C = CONTRCLI1.PROD_C and CONTR.CONTR_N = CONTRCLI1.CONTR_N inner join CLL.CLIAGE CLIAGE1 on CONTRCLI1.CLI_C = CLIAGE1.CLI_C inner join SOGG_POSIZINFORM.DETT_CONTR_BANCA DCB on DCB.CONTR_N = CONTR.CONTR_N and DCB.PROD_C = CONTR.PROD_C inner join SOGG_POSIZINFORM.DOM_STATO_CONTR DSC on cast(DSC.COD_STATO_CONTR AS CHAR(3)) = DCB.COD_STATO_CONTR_EFFETV and DSC.COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR = 'CC'
where CONTRCLI.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' and CONTRCLI1.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' and CLIAGE1.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and CLIAGE1.CLIAGE_D_FINE = TO_DATE('31/12/9999','DD/MM/YYYY') and CONTRCLI1.CONTRCLI_D_FINE_RUOLO = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') and CONTRCLI1.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR in ('I','P') and CLIAGE.GSTD_F_ESIST = 'S' and CLIAGE.CLIAGE_D_FINE = TO_DATE('31/12/9999','DD/MM/YYYY') and CONTR.PROD_C = cast('BAN01' as char(11)) and CONTRCLI.CLI_C = substr('00000000000' ||
ndgCliente, -11) and CONTRCLI.CLI_C in (ndgCliente) and CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_D_FINE_RUOLO = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') and CONTR.CONTR_D_ESTI = TO_DATE('31/12/9999','DD/MM/YYYY')
and CONTR.CONTR_C_CAT not in ('0005', '0043', '0075', '0076', '0044') and whereTipoConto and CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR in ('P', 'I', 'C', 'D')
and 'IT' || nvl(substr(CONTR.CONTR_C_IBAN,1,13),' ') || substr('000000000000' || substr(CONTR.CONTR_N,5,8),-12) =
ibanConto and CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR in (ruoliAmmessi) and CONTR.CONTR_C_DIV in (divisaConto)
order by 1 asc

Access.name: nominativiContoAutocomplete
Access.Query: select case when CONTR.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR = 'I' then 1 when CONTR.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR = 'P' then 2 when CONTR.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR = 'C' then 3 else 4 end as orderBy , CLI.CLI_C , CLI.CLI_M_COGN , CLI.CLI_M_NOM , CONTR.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR , (select DES_RUOLO_CONTR from SOGG_POSIZINFORM.LEGM_RUOLO_TIPO_PROD_CONTR where trim(COD_TIPO_PROD_CONTR) = 'CC' and trim(COD_RUOLO_CONTR_CLI) = trim(CONTR.CONTRCLI_C_RUOLO_CONTR) and rownum=1) as ruoloConto from CLL.CONTRCLI CONTR, CLL.CLI CLI where CONTR.CONTR_N = rpad(?, 20) and CONTR.PROD_C='BAN01' and CONTR.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' and CLI.CLI_C = CONTR.CLI_C order by 1

Access.name: codiceAgevolazioneAutocomplete
Access.Query:
select ag.ID_DEROGA , ag.TIPO_DEROGA , (select td.DESCRIZIONE from CEPE_CRLEVE_DOMINIO_DEROGA td where td.TIPO_DEROGA = ag.TIPO_DEROGA) , ag.MANDATO_ARR , ag.CODICE_CONV , ag.MODAL_VERS , ag.PCT_ESENZ , ag.IMPORTO_INVEST , ag.APPL_DEROGA from CEPE_CRLEVE_MOV_DEROG_GEST ag, CEPE_CRLEVE_LOGATTIVITA log, PDF_INSTANCE pdf where ag.ID_ATTIVITA = log.ID_ATTIVITA and log.PDF_ID = pdf.PDF_INSTANCE_ID and ag.CODICE_CONV is not null
and log.STATO in ('03', '05', '12') and log.PROCESSATA_DA_SEDE is null
and log.STATO in ('03', '05') and not exists (select 1 from PDF_INSTANCE where PDF_INSTANCE.ID_AGEVOLAZIONE = convert(varchar, ag.ID_DEROGA) and prgm.pdfwebforms.model.PdfInstanceModel.CONDIZIONE_STATO_PDF_COMPLETATO_RETE)
and ag.PROD_C_PROD =
codProdottoDispositiva
and ag.MOM_CODE =
pdfMomCode
and PROD_C_PROD_PART like
%codProdottoDispositivaPartenza% and (pdf.COD_AGENTE = (select right('0000000000' +
codAgente, 10)) or pdf.COD_AGE_IMPERSONATO = (select right('0000000000' +
codAgente, 10))) and ag.COD_CLIENTE = (select right('00000000000' +
codCliente, 11)) and ag.MODAL_VERS in (modalitaVersamentoAgevolazione) and (select right('00000000000000000000' + ag.MANDATO_ARR, 20)) = (select right('00000000000000000000' +
numeroContrattoDestinazione, 20)) order by 2

Access.name: prestitoAutocomplete
Access.Query: SELECT CONTRMUTUI.CONTR_N as numero , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_IMPORTOEROG as importoErogato , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_DEBITORESIDUO as debitoResiduo , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_N_TOTALERATE as totaleRate , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_N_TOTALERATEPAGATE as ratePagate , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_D_SCAD as dataScadenza , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_D_SCADPROSSRATA as scadenzaProssimaRata , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_IMPORTOPROSSRATA as importoProssimaRata , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_C_PROGRRAPP as progressivoPiano , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_F_STATOPRESTITI as stato , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_TASSOINIZIALE as tassoIniziale , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_TASSOCORRENTE as tassoCorrente , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_TAEG as taeg , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_I_SPREAD as spread , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_C_CAT as categoria , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_C_SCAT as sottocategoria , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_C_CONV as convenzione , CONTRMUTUI.CONTRMUTUI_C_CONTOCORRREGOLAM as contoCorrenteRegolamento from CLL.CONTRCLI CONTRCLI inner join CLL.CONTR CONTR on CONTRCLI.CONTR_N = CONTR.CONTR_N and CONTRCLI.PROD_C = CONTR.PROD_C inner join CLL.CONTRMUTUI CONTRMUTUI on CONTRCLI.CONTR_N = CONTRMUTUI.CONTR_N and CONTRCLI.PROD_C = CONTRMUTUI.PROD_C where CONTRCLI.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' and CONTRCLI.CLI_C = lpad(?, 11, '0') and CONTRCLI.CONTRCLI_D_FINE_RUOLO > sysdate and CONTR.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' and CONTR.PROD_C = cast('BAN06' as char(11)) and CONTR.CONTR_D_ESTI > sysdate and CONTRMUTUI.GSTD_F_ESIST='S' order by 1 asc
